summary: FRONTEND-ONLY testing of NEW FAQ section + SEO overhaul + Hyderabad local targeting. ALL required criteria pass after resolving one environmental issue (frontend supervisor needed a restart to pick up the new public/index.html — CRA/webpack HtmlWebpackPlugin does not always hot-reload template changes). Post-restart validation: (1) <title> exactly 'Gurjan Marine BWP Plywood — IS 710 Certified | Meridian Plywood, Hyderabad'; meta description contains 'Gurjan Marine BWP' + 'Hyderabad'; geo.region=IN-TG, geo.placename='Hyderabad, Telangana', ICBM='17.3911, 78.4625' present; og:title & twitter:title updated to new Gurjan Marine BWP copy; canonical unchanged (https://www.meridianply.com/). (2) 5 application/ld+json blocks parse as valid JSON (Organization, LocalBusiness, ItemList, FAQPage, WebSite); FAQPage.mainEntity has 6 Question entries and ALL 6 question strings match the visible <summary> text 1:1 (Google FAQ text-match requirement satisfied); ItemList products renamed to 'BWP Gurjan Plywood (IS 710 Boiling Waterproof)' & 'Gurjan Marine Plywood (IS 710 Marine Grade)' with Thickness='18mm, 16mm, 12mm, 9mm, 6mm' on both; LocalBusiness.areaServed = [Hyderabad, Telangana, India]. (3) FAQ section renders between Testimonials and Contact — data-testid=faq-section + 6 faq-item-{0..5} / faq-question-{0..5} / faq-answer-{0..5}; native <details> accordion opens on click, + rotates 45° to × (CSS transform: matrix(0.707,0.707,-0.707,0.707,0,0)), multi-open works (items 0 & 2 both open simultaneously), 2nd click closes; item 5 answer contains both 'Hyderabad' and 'Aghapura'. (4) Layout verified at 1920x800 / 1194x760 / 390x844 with zero horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth on every viewport); mobile columns stack (item0 top > headline top + 40px). (5) Hero img alt='Premium Gurjan BWP marine plywood slab — Meridian Plywood, IS 710 boiling waterproof' contains 'Gurjan BWP marine plywood'; Interiors slide 0 img alt ends with 'built with Meridian Gurjan BWP plywood'. (6) /sitemap.xml returns 200, valid <urlset>, 10 <loc> entries including https://www.meridianply.com/#faq, 10 <lastmod> entries; /robots.txt still references sitemap. (7) REGRESSION: full-page top-to-footer scroll at both 1920x800 and 1194x760 produced ZERO console errors and ZERO page errors; Interiors counter reaches '05' at end of section; max concurrent slides with opacity>0.5 across 20/40/60/80% mid-scroll = 1 (no double-caption regression); anchor navigation to /#contact scrolls #contact into view; FloatingWhatsApp still renders.
action_items: None required for this feature — all acceptance criteria pass. Only environmental note: whenever public/index.html is edited (meta/JSON-LD/title), frontend must be restarted (`sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`) because CRA HtmlWebpackPlugin caches the template and does not always hot-reload it. This was hit on first run — the stale HTML lacked geo tags / FAQPage LD / renamed products; restart resolved it completely.
critical_code_review_comments:
Faq.jsx is clean: native
/ means the answer

stays in the DOM for Googlebot even when visually collapsed — correct choice for FAQPage SEO (Radix would have hidden the DOM node when closed). The

[open] CSS handles icon rotation and text colour without JS state — minimal and robust.

FAQPage JSON-LD questions match the visible <summary> text exactly for all 6 items — this is critical for Google's FAQ rich-result eligibility (mismatch would silently drop the rich result). Also 6 <Question> entries at answers roughly under 350 characters each fits well within Google's guidelines.

LocalBusiness JSON-LD adds keywords + areaServed[City/State/Country] + descriptive name — good local SEO signal; consider adding @id (a stable URL fragment like https://www.meridianply.com/#hyderabad-store) so Organization ↔ LocalBusiness can be linked via sameAs in a future revision, but this is a nice-to-have, not a blocker.

sitemap.xml: all 10 URLs share the same lastmod (2026-06-07) which is fine but slightly unusual — if the marketing team updates only individual sections, per-section lastmod dates would give Googlebot more precise recrawl signals. Non-blocking.

Landing.jsx now inserts <Faq /> between <Testimonials /> and <Contact /> with a section-divider before it — matches the requested placement and preserves the existing anchor order (#faq lands between #portal and #contact in the nav flow).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 7 acceptance areas pass, 0 console errors, 0 page errors

context_for_next_testing_agent: FAQ + SEO feature complete and verified. Key gotcha for future SEO/head edits: CRA HtmlWebpackPlugin caches public/index.html — always `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` after editing public/index.html or the served page will still ship the OLD title/meta/JSON-LD despite the file on disk being new. This burned iteration 7's first pass — value-add tip for future agents editing head tags. Faq.jsx (native <details>) is the source of truth for the 6 questions; index.html JSON-LD must be kept in text-lockstep with FAQS[] in Faq.jsx or Google will silently drop the FAQ rich result.
rca of the issue: First-pass fetch of https://plywood-studio.preview.emergentagent.com/ returned STALE index.html (old title, no geo tags, only 4 LDJSON blocks, no FAQPage, old product names). Root cause: `/app/frontend/public/index.html` was edited at 11:34 but the frontend supervisor process had been running since 11:27 with the previous template cached inside webpack-dev-server's HtmlWebpackPlugin instance. CRA hot-reloads JSX changes but NOT template-level changes to public/index.html. Mitigation: `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` — after restart the served HTML matched /app/frontend/public/index.html byte-for-byte and every SEO/JSON-LD/geo criterion passed. This is expected CRA behaviour, not a code bug.
